paper_of_the_week.practitioner_takeaway: This study may meaningfully inform practice in Women's athlete health. The direction and clinical magnitude of the findings are not reliably extractable. paper_of_the_week.research_takeaway: Future studies should address the identified reporting and methodological limitations, particularly around effect estimates, precision, confounding, and clinical importance where applicable.
major_cautions: Substantial heterogeneity may reduce confidence in the pooled estimate.
The abstract does not clearly report an assessment of publication bias.
Multiple testing may have occurred without a clearly reported correction.
Clinical importance or a minimally important difference is not clearly discussed.

specialist_takeaways.sports_performance: The study is relevant to Sprint speed, Jump performance, Strength. Sports-performance confidence is high. Transfer to competitive athletes depends on training status, intervention specificity, outcome validity, and similarity to real competition demands.
specialist_takeaways.biomechanics: This study evaluates Kinematics, Landing mechanics. Biomechanics confidence is high. Interpret mechanical changes separately from clinical significance; changes in joint angles, forces, or stiffness do not necessarily translate into better performance or lower injury risk.
specialist_takeaways.womens_athlete_health: This paper addresses female-athlete health. Women's-athlete-health confidence is high. Interpretation should consider whether female participants were adequately represented, whether sex-specific analyses were performed, and whether menstrual, hormonal, bone-health, and training variables were measured appropriately.
